Vous aller au bord de la mer en été. Let's look at the different uses of the imparfait. It is used for background and description. It describes a situation that existed in the past, a state of mind or being. Les rues étaient embouteillées. The streets were jammed. La circulation était fluide. The traffic was flowing. The imparfait versus the passé composé As they express a mental or physical state of being, some verbs tend to be used more often in the imparfait than in the passé composé. Vous aller au bord de la mer en été. Let's look at the different uses of the imparfait. It is used for background and description. It describes a situation that existed in the past, a state of mind or being. Les rues étaient embouteillées. The streets were jammed. La circulation était fluide. The traffic was flowing. The imparfait versus the passé composé As they express a mental or physical state of being, some verbs tend to be used more often in the imparfait than in the passé composé.
